llm_Code_Diagnosis: In consuma() the consumer checks p->totale_elementi<2 only once before the first read (lines 21‑22). llm_Code_Diagnosis: In consuma() (lines 165‑172) the logic that chooses which producer to wake is inverted. It signals a high‑priority producer when queue_condition(CV_PROD_HIGH)==0 (i.e., when none are waiting) and signals a low‑priority producer otherwise. Consequently, high‑priority producers never receive a wake‑up, leading to a deadlock that causes the program to hang and the test to time out.
